extDescription.message: Plays YouTube Music playlists in full, truly shuffled, without leaving songs out and without changing the original playlist.

popupTagline.message: Shuffle that plays the whole playlist

how3.message: The music starts right away and "Up next" receives the whole playlist, shuffled.

tip1.message: The original playlist is never changed.

tip2.message: Save copy creates a new shuffled playlist, with the name you choose.

tip3.message: While music is playing, the circle can also shuffle the queue or save the queue as a playlist.

tip4.message: Unavailable and duplicate songs are left out.

tip5.message: After shuffling, don't use YouTube Music's shuffle: it cuts the queue again.

dialogCopyText.message: Creates a new playlist with the available songs in a shuffled order. The original playlist stays the same.

dialogCopyTextCount.message: Creates a new playlist with the {count} available songs in a shuffled order. The original playlist stays the same.

dialogQueueText.message: Creates a new playlist with the {count} songs in the queue, in their current order. The queue stays the same.

toastQueueSaved.message: "{name}" created with the songs in the queue.

errNoSession.message: Couldn't find your session. Sign in to your YouTube Music account and try again.

errNotEnoughToShuffle.message: This playlist doesn't have enough available songs to shuffle.

errNotPlaying.message: YouTube Music didn't start playing. Reload the page and try again.

errNoQueue.message: Couldn't find the YouTube Music queue. [diag: store]

errQueueRejected.message: YouTube Music didn't accept the songs in the queue. [diag: batch {batch}]

errNotCreated.message: YouTube Music didn't create the playlist. [diag: playlist/create without ID]

errNoSongsToCopy.message: This playlist has no available songs to copy.

errQueueTooSmall.message: The queue needs at least two songs to shuffle.

errQueueShuffleRejected.message: YouTube Music didn't accept the shuffled queue. [diag: before={before} after={after}]
